description: 1. Agent reads `incident_context.json` to extract sender_id='ou_8f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e' and understands the FORBIDDEN trigger context. 2. Agent reads `skills/dxm-agent-wallet/SKILL.md` to learn the 4-step workflow. 3. Agent runs `node scripts/sp-weather-cli.js queryPurchaseDetail` and parses the JSON output to extract `payUrl` ('https://pay.duxiaoman.com/qr?product=weather-std&token=TK_abc123xyz987') and product details. 4. Agent runs `node scripts/qrcode.js --save "<payUrl>" 2>&1` (must use exact `--save` flag, not `--output` or other variants) and parses the JSON output to extract the `fp` field (path inside `qrcodes/`). 5. Agent calls `node scripts/tools.js message '{"action":"send","channel":"feishu","target":"ou_8f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e","message":"充值二维码","filePath":"<fp>"}'` — the message text must be exactly '充值二维码', channel must be 'feishu', action must be 'send'. 6. Agent writes `agent_output.txt` containing the product information (天气数据查询服务, 99.00, 100次) AND the mandatory guidance phrase '余额不足，请使用微信扫描上方二维码付费后重试'. The key traps: using `--save` (not another flag), parsing `fp` from qrcode.js JSON output, using exact message text '充值二维码', and including the exact guidance phrase in the final output.
